const d = moire.gpu.device; const rb = async (buf, size) => { const b = d.createBuffer({size, usage: GPUBufferUsage.MAP_READ | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST}); const e = d.createCommandEncoder(); e.copyBufferToBuffer(buf, 0, b, 0, size); d.queue.submit([e.finish()]); await b.mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ); const a = b.getMappedRange().slice(0); b.unmap(); b.destroy(); return a; }; const C = moire.cells, n = C.count, CF = C.cellBuf.size / 4 / n; const cf = new Float32Array(await rb(C.cellBuf, n * CF * 4)), cu = new Uint32Array(cf.buffer); const CC = moire.eat.carbon; const cb = new Int32Array(await rb(CC.buf, n * 24 * 4)); const kB = CC.params.kBody, R = C.R; let alive = 0, bat = 0, body = 0, both = 0, grown = 0, all3 = 0, batSum = 0; const hb = [0,0,0,0,0]; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (!(cu[i * CF + 9] & 1)) continue; alive++; const b = cf[i * CF + 16], r = cf[i * CF + 4]; const want = kB * Math.PI * (r / R) ** 2 * 4096, have = 0.25 * (2 * cb[i * 24 + 8] + cb[i * 24 + 9] + cb[i * 24 + 10]); const okB = b >= 0.6, okC = !CC.params.growth || have >= 0.995 * want, okR = r >= 0.9 * R; batSum += b; hb[Math.min(4, Math.floor(b * 5))]++; if (okB) bat++; if (okC) body++; if (okB && okC) both++; if (okR) grown++; if (okB && okC && okR) all3++; } return JSON.stringify({ready: {alive, bat, body, both, grown, all3, batMean: batSum / Math.max(alive, 1), batHist: hb}})
